description: Submit a request for TutorPing to match a student with a tutor, when search_tutors finds no fit or the user prefers to be matched. TutorPing replies by email within 1 business day with tutor options. Collect what the student needs, then confirm the details AND get the user's explicit agreement that TutorPing may share the request and contact details with matching tutors before calling. Ask only for a first name, never a child's full name.

consent.description: The user agreed TutorPing may share this request and contact details with matching tutors

email.description: Where TutorPing should send tutor options

location.description: City or area for in-person; omit if online only

notes.description: Goals, current scores, anything a tutor should know

online.description: true if online sessions are fine

tutorRef.description: tutorRef of a profile from search_tutors the user liked; TutorPing asks that tutor first

name: request_tutor
title: Ask TutorPing to find a tutor
